## Polite Decline 1.0

First release.

- Turns down duel requests and group invitations from strangers and hides their popups.
- Friends, Battle.net friends and guild mates always get through, and so does everyone on your own allow list.
- When it cannot tell who someone is, it lets the request through rather than decline it by mistake.
- One chat line per declined request with the name and a count for this session. `/pd quiet on` turns the lines off.
- `/pd` or `/politedecline` shows the settings. `/pd duels on|off` and `/pd invites on|off` switch each half, `/pd allow Name`, `/pd unallow Name` and `/pd list` keep the allow list.

## Polite Decline 1.1

- New **reply whisper**: a stranger whose duel or group invite was declined can get one short, polite whisper, so they know it was not personal. It is off until you switch it on with `/pd whisper on`.
- The default reply is "Thanks, but I don't take duels or group invites from people I don't know. Have a good day!" `/pd whisper text` followed by your own words sets your own (up to 200 characters), `/pd whisper reset` brings back the default, `/pd whisper` shows the reply.
- No spam: the same character gets the whisper at most once every 30 minutes, and two whispers never go out within 10 seconds.
- No whispers inside dungeons, raids, battlegrounds, arenas or scenarios, or while the game has chat locked. Declining works there as before.
- Friends, guild mates, your allow list and anyone the addon is unsure about are never whispered, because they are never declined.
- Your settings and allow list from 1.0 are kept.

- The help text now reads "on/off" instead of "on|off", which the chat could show garbled.

## Polite Decline 1.2

- New **log**: every duel and group invite that Polite Decline turns down is noted with the time, the name and the kind of request, also in quiet mode.
- `/pd log` lists what was declined this session, newest first, with the number of declines so far.
- `/pd log all` lists the last 50 declined requests across all your sessions and characters, so you can see who kept asking while you were busy.
- `/pd log clear` empties the log.
- Requests that got through (friends, guild mates, your allow list, anyone the addon was unsure about) are not logged, because they were not declined.
- `/pd` now mentions `/pd log` in its help. Your settings, allow list and reply whisper from 1.0 and 1.1 are kept.
